shots.title: Evidence: one row
shots.caption: Version 21 had a strip of tabs, a strip of kinds and a row of filters. Now: the page's two tabs, then one row: search, the view, Kind, Review, Owner, then More and Add evidence.

shots.title: The view menu
shots.caption: The quick filters that stood as chips are built-in views with their counts; your saved views follow them; Save as new view, Manage views.

shots.title: Manage views
shots.caption: Rename a saved view, choose who sees it, delete it, or save the current filters as a new one.

shots.title: Controls: one row
shots.caption: Family, the quick filters and the list's actions stood in three places. Now they are one row over the table.

open: The workspace's own pages (Home, My work, Review queue, Programs, Products, Library) are still v2's: they take the window's width now, but keep v2's toolbar and 48px rows. The one row and saved views are on the program's ten places.

Between about 1180 and 1360px of window a list with five filters keeps one row by cutting the filters' names; under 1180px the row wraps to two, and a phone gives it three (search and view, a strip of filters that scrolls sideways, the actions).
Saved views live in the session, like every record of the prototype: Reset clears them and each list starts again with its built-in views and one seeded view.
